Tessa / Ben — I've reviewed Novacare's redlines. Summary of my proposed edits (see attached 'Novacare_MSA_redline_response_20270412.docx'):

1) Licensed runtime boundary — propose explicit definition: "Licensed Runtime" means the compiled model artifacts and runtime image provided by Redwood for deployment within customer-controlled infrastructure, excluding customer data, telemetry and any third-party system images. This gives a clear handback artifact (image + model checksum) for audit.

2) Snapshot deposit / escrow-like mechanism — we cannot deposit full source or training data. We can offer: (a) periodic read-only forensic snapshots (tarball of deployed image + runtime logs limited to the last 72 hours) delivered via secure transfer, and (b) a signed manifest with sha256 checksums of the runtime artifacts stored in customer's secure bucket for up to 12 months. For the witnessing event, propose a 2-day in-scope session with a scoped list of artifacts (see evidence matrix) and an ops runbook.

3) Witnessing and access window — propose 'witness session' scheduled as a mutually agreed 2 business day window. During the window Redwood will provide a console in read-only mode, transfers of signed manifests, and the presence of an ops engineer to step through the runbook. Access will be IAM-limited and timeboxed.

4) Liability / indemnity / preservation — minor redline to limit Redwood's obligation only to artifacts created and signed by Redwood; we cannot accept preservation obligations beyond what our storage policy supports.

5) Documentation / evidence delivery — propose to add an Order Form exhibit listing the evidence deliverables and delivery SLA (15 business days from written request for archived snapshots; expedited 5-day SLA possible for an additional fee).

I've attached the draft response and inline edits. If Novacare needs a true escrow deposit with third-party escrow vendor, we can explore that but that will be out-of-scope under standard onboarding and would require a customer-paid escrow setup and scope.

Next actions: Ben — confirm ops availability the week of Apr 26 and whether the 72-hour log window and signed manifests are operationally feasible. Tessa — if you want, I can draft a short exhibit for the Order Form that enumerates deliverables and SLAs so Novacare can sign off quickly.
